text:
The schedule from my earlier answer satisfies all 17 constraints when I re-check it slot by slot.

- Finn is in slot 1 and Hana is immediately after, in slot 2.
- Dev is in slot 4, so Elif in slot 3 is the one person between Dev and Hana. Dev and Finn are 3 slots apart.
- Elif (3) is before Ben (5), with one person between them. Elif is also before Ivo.
- Cara (6) and Dev (4) are both before Gus (7), and Gus and Hana are 5 slots apart.
- Ivo is in slot 9, with Gus (7) leaving one person between them. Ivo comes after Hana, Elif and Cara.
- Dev and Ivo are 5 slots apart, and Ben and Ivo are 4 slots apart.
- Ann is in slot 8, 6 slots after Hana and 3 slots from Ben.

I only worked through the case where Ivo is two slots after Gus. I didn't prove the schedule is unique. It does satisfy every stated constraint.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Finn","2":"Hana","3":"Elif","4":"Dev","5":"Ben","6":"Cara","7":"Gus","8":"Ann","9":"Ivo"}
CONFIDENCE: 97
